The Hall of Thanes.from: a stone tablet in the vault behind the last room

The Drowned City.text: Make rubbings of the four tablets.

Krol'dok Stronghold.title: Krol'dok Moulding

Blackmaw Hold.title: The Twin Bears

Blackmaw Hold.title: Blackmaw Magic
Blackmaw Hold.text: Take the Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Elder Shaman Bloodmane.

Alcaz Prison.title: The Man in the Iron Chains

Alcaz Prison.title: Thrall Needs to Know

The Shaper's Terrace.text: Gather a Drained Crystal Fragment near the Achromatic Crystal.
